item.text:
Finished the Bun bundler migration in [build.ts](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-tMsr0N/workspace/build.ts). It now builds for Bun with production JSX output and keeps `NODE_ENV` available at runtime. The handler uses the package’s `@shop/orders` export, and [Dockerfile](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-tMsr0N/workspace/Dockerfile) includes the source needed by the container’s `source-runtime` condition.

**Evidence:** `bun run build`, `bun run typecheck`, and `bun test` passed. I built and ran the production image; `/health` returned `200 ok`, `POST /orders` returned `201` with `orderId: "order-1"` and the confirmation HTML, and the seed guard reported `seed refused` under production. The temporary container was stopped.
